t: Vending Box - BaseballCardPedia.com
s: Topps made vending boxes as early as the 1950s. But while trading card vending machines were relegated to antique shops by the 70s, Topps kept making the boxes up until the mid 1990s. They became a popular way for dealers put together sets (you can get most of a set out of two boxes), and a way for collectors to get a lot of cards for relatively little money.
